identityNotes: The feed MPN fields are empty. Numeric merchantVariantSku values identify the exact advertiser feed variant; they are not asserted to be manufacturer part numbers. Single-unit/base variants were selected instead of monitor, extra-filter or multi-unit bundles.

Supplier award, certification, performance and promotional artwork is preserved in the originals; it is not independent verification or a new site claim.
Waterdrop G3P800 has an original small white edge area; display it on a white opaque image surface.
The Renogy panel image shows front and rear views of one panel; it must not imply a two-panel quantity.
Production rendering of the separately wired model photos still requires a later authorized release and verification.
